title: A Ghost for the Protocol
author: Beatrix Lockridge
blurb: Hazel Pemberton, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
